title: rose curtains of the bongo martillo
story: O Tu o Yo enters the harmonic change at 4805 (bar 86, C# over A#), after a bachata martillo that already plays. Before it, the tunnel travels slow and steady; every stroke of the martillo flicks the bubble size (escala) and the open tone swells the bubble count and brightness; the big hits on 4583, 4896, 5010, 5109 punch zoom and shake. At 4805 the new chord turns the palette to cooler rose (hue -0.08) and opens contrast, and it stays there while the half-bar flips keep the room breathing.
